template: Residential rental property application fee not to exceed $50 would cover this address but is not yet in effect; it takes effect on 2026-05-01. Source: P.L. 2025, c.405 (A4899 4R); N.J.S.A. C.46:8-18.1; as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
rewrite: A New Jersey rule limiting residential rental application fees to $50 will apply to this address, but it does not take effect until 2026-05-01. Source: P.L. 2025, c.405 (A4899 4R); N.J.S.A. C.46:8-18.1; as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
